name: apana-plugin
description: The apana plugin for Claude Code: skills and hooks that do not call Jev.
author: Alexandru-Cristian Pana

scripts.test:omlx: $(command -v python3.13 || command -v python3.12 || command -v python3.11 || command -v python3.10 || command -v python3) -B -W ignore::ResourceWarning -m unittest discover -s skills/omlx/scripts -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.test:claude-auto: (cd skills/install-claude-auto/assets && python3 -B -W ignore test_claude_auto.py) && (cd skills/install-claude-auto/scripts && python3 -B -W ignore test_setup.py)
